name: varterm
description: Reads Claude's replies aloud in a natural voice. No model download, no Python, and the same voice you get in the editor and the browser.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: A Microsoft neural voice id, for example en-US-EmmaNeural or en-GB-RyanNeural. Over a hundred languages are available.

rate.title: Speaking rate
rate.description: 1 is normal speed. 1.25 is a comfortable skim.

max_chars.title: Longest reply to read
max_chars.description: Replies longer than this are skipped rather than read at length. Set high to always read.
